description: AGSC-06-41 with the confinement of the PROV-O terms: the PROV-O terms prov:generatedAtTime and prov:wasAttributedTo appear in the Dataset block of the home page and in no other output of the build: not in graph.jsonld, graph.ttl or graph.nq (their bytes and the @context address stay those of 1.0), not in a pages/<slug>.jsonld, not in the block of another index page. The fixture is the minimal Bundle built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history, with site.author and site.author_orcid configured so that prov:wasAttributedTo is present; the expected list names every emitted file that contains either term. Derived by hand from the rule.
note: The build harness (source_date_epoch 1767225600, no git history) is that of build-0029; the case has no handler yet (expected red until the Dataset block lands).
